test(apk-0232 r3, picker N1): P9 -- a cancel or a new Prepare in the gap between the poll's 'bound' and its record

Test hook SetTestBeforeLocalCommitHook (test builds only) holds the poll there; the user's call runs on its own
thread. FAIL if A is recorded selected after that call finished; with B, B completes with its own IDR (701).
GateSink gets the same CommitLocalSelectionFor as the Android sink. 56/56; the r2 poll shape (read, then record
outside the sink) as a mutant: both P9 boundary checks FAIL.
